Builds for each character LOTR Journeys into the middle
earth by Ternizator

I created some builds, using the best cards in my opinion, so some of the
builds are overlapping like boasting builds (Gimli melee PVM, Eleanor
Support/Controller, Beorn). So be aware of that when you're building your

party.

Aragorn Tank Tactics (Guardian/Captain)
|

The idea of this build is to use the banner to generate inspiration and tank a lot, lure the enemies
and tank. Using global support. (Final Defense and Master Tactician) It may sound
counterintuitive, with Aragorn’s passive, but when tanking, he can use those global cards, to
support other players, and stay tanking all monsters and luring them. Besides that, the Iron-Render
can kill any monster easily, with cleave of the War Maker late-game, then later changing for a more
tactical approach when upgrading for Hope's Beacon.
The idea when you have the late game Hope’s Beacon, is to use the tactics and guards to scout
more tactics and guard.
- Deck composition 19 cards
- 10 Tactics/Guards (Banner Synergy)
- Master Tactician, discarding tactics for example, scout 3, prepare a card, and scout one
more, because of the banner, and the benefit of obvious support for other players to scout 3.
- Stand Together, preparing 2 cards with the banner trigger, and supporting other players
that are nearby to scout 1.
- Guarded Strike, to add 1 inspiration discarding tactics with guard, and scouting 1 trading the
discarded card for a free new card with the banner late game.
- Defense instruction for global negation, another global support like Master Tactician.
- King's Crest once per phase can discard a card, to generate 2 more cards revealed in the
test. (this with Hope’s Beacon, can trigger discard a tactic, to scout 1)
- Iron Render + Strider for high damage plus strikes with Guarded Strike. (Damage
generating inspiration)
- Ifyou are lucky enough to be in an exploration map, and “Wanderer” shows in the first turn,
just prepare it, and explore the maximum number of tiles possible, to prepare multiple cards.

[Prepared Cards]

Guarded Strike / Ready Defense / Defense Instruction

Simple build, the idea of this build is to trigger the Beravor passive, using sprint generating a lot of
inspiration for exploration, and using the travel Garb to grab more sprint cards.

sprint for another trigger and more movement.

Use Find a way to generate status determined, that can synergy with Quick Thinking to
generate status: Emboldened or Hidden.

Paths Unseen to teleport characters across the map.

Can use words of warning and unstoppable to add successes to attacks and unstoppable to

The idea of the build is to prepare Embrace Darkness, to prevent damage and to use the high cap
for fear of Bilbo, while gaining a lot of inspiration with songs synergying with Bilbo cards like Simple
Desires. The build is surprisingly tank with this concept, once you prepare Embrace the Darkness
you're golden.

Word of Fortune because it's a free success + scout.

Endless wonder to prepare songs and gain inspiration (6 songs with good uses in deck)
(Bilbo already has one song The Road Goes Ever On that you want to prepare because it's
like a sprint 1 for each hero nearby).

Bilbo Simple Desires card, generates inspiration for each aid, song, food (7 cards in deck)
and scout 2, possibly preparing another song card for Endless wonder, generating another 1
inspiration.

The improved padded armor makes suffering fear facedown, and can use the generated
inspiration to tank fear from enemies (you can remove the hide to prevent all damage.
Using A Bit of Nonsense or Tale of Tinuviel you heal the fear generated by Embrace the
Darkness. Well nourished can flip down and heal with rest too.

5 Hides on the deck.

Uses the Whistler for applying stunning in range (quaranteed with Hidden), and can
generate inspiration with the songs.

The deck have:

The idea of this build is to combine the base cards from Elena, and Traveller base cards, to have a lot
of knowledge and song at the same time. It generates a lot of inspiration and Elena can give those
for other team members in range because of the sling or any testing.

The Whistler adds inspiration for each song, each attack can generate 4 inspiration (when
having 4 songs prepared)

Using Strong Opinion can generate successes consistently because you can fetch it with the
shield.

This build is very consistent in controlling, exploring, attacking and solving map problems.
Another cool point is that if Elena is walking side by side with another character, she can give
her inspiration for other characters (She generates a lot of inspiration with sling, and and
solving map problems, attacking or defending, she can give her inspiration, Wanderlust
have a great synergy with her passive)

Prepare the cards Lay of Twilight and Many Paths to Tread (They have synergy with the
Whistler and Strong Opinion. Once you have the setup, you can attack and generate
consistently inspiration and stun enemies, or use inspiration to solve tokens in the map, and
use strong opinion for generating 3-4 successes. When using Strong Opinion, try to receive
one attack from a minion to get it back with a shield.

Many Paths to Tread when prepared, and solving map tokens, can scout cards for you, so
you can prepare more cards (limited by 5) (another option is to go 3 more scenarios, to get
the meddler card Contemplation (knowledge type) that can prepare 6 cards counting itself +
the armor, so 7 but I prefer to not include this to start using traveler earlier to have the 4
copies of songs+knowledge)

This Gimli build is just about consistency, prepare the Glory with the shield, then prepare boasting
when you have those 2 cards set, the fun starts. Extra attacks, removing fear generated with
boasting with rest 3, this is a very consistent Gimli build.

Shield to fetch Glory and consistently fetching Comrade in arms, that can fetch restless axe
or On your orders for multiple actions (one more action per turn, is broken).

Sleep Anywhere can flip faceup damage and fear from everyone, and heals the Glory
damage too, this is very consistent, and it's a success card that combines with Gimli passive.
Attacking reveals 5 cards with the Sun-Silver, digging down easier the Glory card.

The Heavy Armor, with Glory and Boasting, can generate inspiration and can scout extra
actions.

6 tactics in total in the deck, that can be used with Love of War and Valour.

With Flame-Guard can do 11 damage total (pierce), with Restless Axe 13.

Legolas is one of the best characters in the game (if not the best character), and it's possible to
create multiple builds with him. I wanted to create the ultimate exploration/action economy king
character, using the Pathfinder, but I wanted to include more broken cards with him. Enters the
Meddler, that adds the Hidden Plans card, to add more action economy and setup easier for. In
exploration maps, it's totally broken, he can explore all the maps, and teleport other characters with
Paths Unseen.

- Explore a tile, scout 4 with the Wanderer’s Wish, prepare sprint cards, or Hidden Plans. Gain
1 inspiration while sprinting, keep doing this fueling your inspiration to 5, use Legolas
passive to move 1 more. (Usually this play explores all the tiles in one turn in late game)

- Tireless for one more action to solve maps or kill some enemy and receive inspiration +
movement from daggers.

- Unstoppable is very good, with multiple sprint cards prepared, can add 4 successes to attack
with daggers, or solve any test in the map.

- Be aware of, sometimes, when you prepared Hidden Plans, it's worth to leave maps not
revealed to trigger again the Wanderer’s Wish, preparing Hidden Plans, multiple times is
very broken, you can teleport characters across the map with Paths Unseen, or prepare
multiple Unstoppable and solve tokens easy.
